daisy: She picked a wild daisy by the road and put it in her hair.
她在路边摘了一朵野雏菊,别在了头发上。
odourless: The gas is odourless, so every home should have a detector.
这种气体没有气味,所以每个家庭都应安装探测器。
musty: The old books in the box gave off a musty smell.
箱子里的旧书散发出一股霉味。
fruity: This white wine has a fresh, fruity taste that many people enjoy.
这款白葡萄酒带有清爽的果味,很多人都喜欢。
billboard: A huge billboard near the station advertises a new mobile phone.
车站附近有一块巨大的广告牌,宣传一款新手机。
turn… into: Some caterpillars turn into beautiful butterflies in just a few weeks.
有些毛毛虫只需几周就能变成美丽的蝴蝶。
advert: I saw an advert for a cheap flight to London on television last night.
昨晚我在电视上看到一则飞往伦敦的特价航班广告。
fit into: The new sofa is too big to fit into our small living room.
这张新沙发太大了,放不进我们的小客厅。
rely on: You cannot always rely on others; you must learn to be independent.
你不能总是依赖别人,必须学会独立。
have no use for: I have no use for these old magazines, so please take them away.
这些旧杂志我用不上了,请把它们拿走吧。
disonest: People who tell lies are dishonest, so nobody wants to be friends with them.
撒谎的人不诚实,所以没有人愿意和他们做朋友。
immoral: Many people think it is immoral to sell fake medicine to sick people.
很多人认为把假药卖给病人是不道德的。
offending: He apologized at once for his offending words at the meeting.
他为自己在会上伤人的话立刻道了歉。
add up: These numbers just don't add up, so check them again carefully.
这些数字根本对不上,所以再仔细核对一遍。
calm(…)down: Take a deep breath and calm down before you make a decision.
先深呼吸冷静下来,然后再做决定。
have got to: You have got to finish your homework before you watch television.
你必须先完成作业才能看电视。
be concerned about: Parents always seem to be concerned about their children's safety at school.
父母似乎总是担心孩子在学校的安全。
walk the dog: Every evening after supper, I walk the dog around the quiet park.
每天晚饭后,我都带着狗在安静的公园里遛一遛。
Jewish: My friend David comes from a Jewish family that celebrates special holidays.
我的朋友大卫来自一个庆祝特殊节日的犹太家庭。
Nazi: During the war, the family hid from the Nazis in a secret room for two years.
战争期间,这家人在密室里躲避纳粹长达两年。
set down: She set down her heavy bag and rested for a few minutes.
她放下沉重的包,休息了几分钟。
a series of: The city has suffered a series of storms since the beginning of the month.
自月初以来,这座城市遭遇了一连串风暴。
Kitty: In her diary, Anne wrote to Kitty as if she were a close friend.
在日记里,安妮把基蒂当作亲密的朋友来倾诉。
on purpose: He didn't break the window on purpose; it was really an accident.
他不是故意打碎窗户的,那真的是个意外。
at dusk: We like to walk along the river and watch the sunset at dusk.
我们喜欢在黄昏时分沿着河边散步,看日落。
face to face: After writing to each other for years, the two friends finally met face to face.
互通书信多年之后,这两位朋友终于面对面相见了。
not…any longer: I used to play basketball every weekend, but not any longer.
我以前每个周末都打篮球,但现在不了。
get tired of: You will get tired of eating the same food every day.
天天吃同样的食物,你会吃腻的。
be tired of: He seemed to be tired of answering the same questions again and again.
他似乎厌倦了一遍又一遍地回答同样的问题。
pack (sth) up: Before moving house, she packed up all her books and winter clothes.
搬家之前,她把所有的书和冬衣都打包好了。
Margot: Margot, Anne's elder sister, was quiet and did very well at school.
玛戈是安妮的姐姐,她性格文静,学习成绩很好。
get along with: It is important to learn how to get along with your classmates.
学会如何与同学相处很重要。
Amy: Amy spent the whole afternoon preparing a birthday card for her mother.
艾米花了整个下午为妈妈准备生日贺卡。
come up: If any questions come up during the trip, please call me at once.
旅行中如果出现任何问题,请立刻给我打电话。
at present: At present, more than two hundred students live in this school hall.
目前,有两百多名学生住在这栋校舍里。
make use of: You should make use of every chance to practise your spoken English.
你应该利用每一个机会练习英语口语。
Samuel Johnson: Samuel Johnson spent about nine years writing his famous English dictionary.
塞缪尔·约翰逊花了大约九年时间编写他那部著名的英语词典。
Noah Webster: Noah Webster published his first American dictionary at the age of forty-eight.
诺厄·韦伯斯特在四十八岁时出版了第一部美式词典。
play a part (in): Parents play a part in helping children build good study habits.
父母在帮助孩子养成良好学习习惯方面发挥着作用。
change one’s mind: It is quite common to change one's mind after learning more facts.
在了解更多情况之后改变主意是很常见的事。
